jobs.title: Director - Data Solution Delivery, Wealth Management
jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 262549

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

The Director – Data Solution Delivery, Wealth Management, is accountable for developing, leading, and overseeing the activities of delivery teams responsible for working with cross-functional development teams and business stakeholders to define and implement business strategies, product roadmaps, service offerings, and new features. This is a demanding hands-on and strategic role that requires knowledge of the financial services sector and emerging trends in the Wealth and Asset Management industry.

Is this role right for you? In this role you will:

Take ownership of end-to-end delivery of wealth data exchange engineering use cases and work closely with business and technology stakeholders.
Participate in Data Engineering, Data Architecture strategy, medallion data hub architecture, and roadmap definition and review process.
Demonstrate strong experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) data services and Databricks.
Provide thought leadership in selecting next-generation technologies and architecture components as per the latest trends and Scotiabank standards, frameworks, and best practices.
Promote a data-first mindset across the enterprise to enable Scotiabank to become a stronger data-driven organization.
Identify, monitor, and mitigate cross-project or cross-program dependencies while managing relationships, anticipating/mitigating risks, facilitating communications, and leading projects in an agile fashion.
Engage sponsoring executives and project team members, establishing trusted partnerships to ensure deliveries within scope, budget, and timelines while effectively communicating and discussing analytic insights with senior stakeholders.
Balance collaboration and consensus with the ability to assert project management discipline where required, while being a seasoned practitioner in leading project teams through fast and complex projects.
Work in an agile manner to onboard data, define ETL business processes, and create and manage a data dictionary and data lineage.
Lead a team of data engineers and full-stack developers.
Excel in relationship, stakeholder management, influencing, and negotiation skills, effective at all levels up to senior executives.
Efficiently perform management tasks including incident response and escalations, vendor and contract management, infrastructure management, service resiliency, and service ownership.
Enjoy the challenges of working on different types of projects (from large complex to simple).
Collaborate with various business functions to ensure Wealth Technology meets business needs.

Skills

Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We'd love to work with you if you have:

Minimum 10+ years in a data engineering-focused role.
Hands-on technical leadership with proven experience leading and mentoring engineering teams.
Expertise in implementing Google Cloud Platform (GCP) data services such as DataProc, Dataflow, CloudSQL, BigQuery, CloudSpanner in combination with third parties such as Spark, Apache Beam/Composer, DBT, Cloud PubSub, Confluent Kafka, Cloud Storage, Cloud Functions, and GitHub.
Experience with data streaming and technologies such as Kafka, Spark-streaming, etc.
Effective programming/query skills and in-depth knowledge of common data manipulation, visualization, and analytical tools (e.g., Python, Java, PowerBI, etc.).
Analytical, insights-driven with the ability to help the organization leverage data-driven decisions.
Strong architecture knowledge with experience in providing technical solutions for cloud infrastructure.
Active Google Cloud Data Engineer certification or Google Professional Cloud Architect certification.

What's in it for you?

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Allyship - We strive to create an inclusive culture where every employee is empowered to reach their fullest potential, respected for who they are, and are embraced through bias-free practices and inclusive values across Scotiabank. We embrace diversity and provide opportunities for all employee to learn, grow & participate through our various Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that span across diverse gender identities, ethnicity, race, age, ability & veterans.
Accessibility and Workplace Accommodations - We value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Scotiabank continues to locate, remove and prevent barriers so that we can build a diverse and inclusive environment while meeting accessibility requirements.
Upskilling through online courses, cross-functional development opportunities, and tuition assistance.
Competitive Rewards program including bonus, flexible vacation, personal, sick days and benefits will start on day one.
Dynamic Ecosystem - Free tea & coffee, universal washrooms, and lots of space for team collaboration.
Community Engagement - We offer opportunities for community engagement & belonging with our various programs such as hackathons.

Location(s): Canada : Ontario : Toronto

Scotiabank is a leading bank in the Americas. Guided by our purpose: "for every future", we help our customers, their families and their communities achieve success through a broad range of advice, products and services, including personal and commercial banking, wealth management and private banking, corporate and investment banking, and capital markets.

At Scotiabank, we value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. If you require accommodation (including, but not limited to, an accessible interview site, alternate format documents, ASL Interpreter, or Assistive Technology) during the recruitment and selection process, please let our Recruitment team know. If you require technical assistance, please click here. Candidates must apply directly online to be considered for this role. We thank all applicants for their interest in a career at Scotiabank; however, only those candidates who are selected for an interview will be contacted.

jobs.title: Director, Clinical Data Management
jobs.description:
Everest Clinical Research (“Everest”) is a full-service contract research organization (CRO) providing a broad range of expertise-based clinical research services to worldwide pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device industries. We serve some of the best-known companies and work with many of the most advanced drugs, biologics, and medical devices in development today.

Everest has been an independent CRO since 2004 with a strong foundation as a statistical and data management center of excellence. Building on this foundation, Everest has successfully developed and established itself as a full-service CRO. Everest’s Corporate headquarters are located in Ontario, Canada and US headquarters in New Jersey, USA, with additional physical offices in Asia and Europe.

Everest is known in the industry for its high-quality deliverables, superior customer service, and flexibility in meeting clients’ needs. A dynamic organization with an entrepreneurial origin, Everest continues to experience exceptional growth and great success.

Quality is our backbone, customer-focus is our tradition, flexibility is our strength…that’s us…that’s Everest.

To drive continued success in this exciting clinical research field, we are seeking committed, skilled, and customer-focused individuals to join our winning team as Director, Clinical Data Management
for our Toronto/Markham, Ontario, Canada on-site location, or remotely from a home-based office anywhere in Canada in accordance with our Work from Home policy.

ACCOUNTABILITIES:

Establish and control clinical data operations to provide complete, valid, safe, and secure databases which meet corporate and regulatory clinical data requirements.

Develop and manage clinical data management budget and resource plans and perform ongoing assessment and control for the utilization of resources and budget. Achieve divisional objectives within the agreed upon budget.

Manage client project portfolios in conjunction with other corporate executives. Maintain strong client relations. Assist in the development of project bids for new projects.

Ensure timely availability of the clinical data capture instruments and databases, and contribute to their completeness, validity, and effectiveness for use in product development, local registration, and support by planning and directing the integration of clinical CRF design, database definition, database administration, data entry, data management, storage, and QC and QA.

Integrate the operations of Clinical Data Management with the requirements of the Quality Assurance and Compliance, Project Management, Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Statistical Programming, and Medical Writing functional areas to assure cooperative realization of corporate objectives and to optimize the productivity and effectiveness of clinical data management.

Perform competitive bench marking of clinical data operations to ensure that data management techniques and procedures used are the best in the class.

Plan, direct, and follow up on the establishment of data management guidelines and procedures which are in line with industry good data management practices.

Participate and contribute to the corporate efforts, in investigating, establishing, and implementing new and advanced systems, standards, and procedures to improve the effectiveness of data capture and management.

Recruit, train, motivate, and develop staff to ensure high levels of performance with strong professional and technical expertise. Complete annual and semi‑annual performance reviews. Plan, implement, and oversee staff training and development process.

Plan, manage, and control resources to effectively fulfill unit and corporate missions, goals, and policies.

QUALIFICATIONS:

A M.Sc. in Computer Science, Biostatistics or Mathematics, or Life Sciences. Lower academic degrees will be acceptable with proven abilities and the level of expertise required for the job.

At least 15 years’ of Clinical Data Management experience including a minimum of 3 years line management experience.

A comprehensive knowledge of the systems, programs, and operations required to collect, store, perform QC and QA and process clinical data to meet international standards including 21 CFR Part 11 and ICH guidelines.

Experience leading a team with exceptional people management skills in dealing with the various functional areas within the company including the ability to interact successfully and communicate effectively with personnel at all levels within the organization.

Experience in the design and implementation of Standard Operating Procedures for Clinical Data Management.

Experience with client relationship management and developing future business is preferred.

Demonstrated ability to effectively manage clinical/medical information and organize and integrate the activities of information processing personnel; excellent analytical and creative problem solving skills; excellent client relationship management skills; commitment to process improvement; ability to develop and implement strategic operations and process to ensure peak performance and gain efficiencies; providing technical expertise and ability to manage high profile projects; communicating effectively, orally and in writing, with personnel at all professional and administrative levels; leading or participating in the evaluation and implementation of new systems, processes, and standards; leading and directing the development and implementation of new standards and procedures to improve the effectiveness and efficiency of clinical data management.

To find out more about Everest Clinical Research and to review other opportunities, please visit our website at www.everestclinical.com.

Estimated Salary Range: $170,000 - 190,000.

We thank all interested applicants, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Everest is committed to upholding the principles of dignity, independence, integration, and equal opportunity. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities, and upon request we will provide accommodations for candidates participating in any part of our recruitment and selection process.

jobs.title: Director, PathWise Actuarial Implementation and AI-Enabled Process Transformation
jobs.description:
The Life Solutions division at Aon is seeking a Director to lead large-scale PathWise implementation projects. This role also supports AI-enabled process transformation initiatives for life and annuity insurers across North America. This client-facing role combines actuarial expertise, implementation leadership, and technology-enabled transformation to help insurers modernize modelling, reporting, workflow automation, AI-enabled systems, and operational workflows.

The Director will work within Aon Life Solutions, part of Aon’s Reinsurance Strategy and Technology Group to translate business needs into practical implementation plans, scalable operating models, and measurable delivery outcomes. This role will be based in Canada.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada. This role is not eligible for sponsorship, and we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa or work permit.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What The Day Will Look Like

Implementation and Client Delivery

Lead and support large-scale PathWise implementation projects for life and annuity insurers across North America.
Handle key implementation workstreams, including model migration, data integration, testing, reconciliation, workflow design, documentation, training, and production deployment.
Translate client business objectives and current-state processes into clear delivery plans, target-state solutions, and implementation roadmaps.
Develop and migrate actuarial models and production processes for valuation, pricing, financial reporting, capital, ALM, and risk management use cases.
Support delivery governance, issue resolution, risk management, collaborator communication, post-implementation stabilization, and client knowledge transfer.

AI-Enabled Process Transformation and Innovation

Identify, prioritize, and continuously refine opportunities to use automation and AI-enabled capabilities to improve actuarial modelling, reporting, reconciliation, documentation, and analysis processes across the PathWise lifecycle.
Collaborate closely with the PathWise AI and development teams to translate business difficulties into clear AI use cases, feature requests, and improvements.
Help clients redesign legacy actuarial workflows into more efficient, scalable, governed, and technology-enabled operating models.
Contribute to reusable implementation assets, process transformation playbooks, documentation templates, workflow designs, and AI-enabled delivery accelerators.
Lead or support pilots of new PathWise AI features, capturing user feedback and performance metrics, and consolidating insights into actionable recommendations for the PathWise AI roadmap
Promote responsible and controlled use of AI-enabled capabilities, including review, validation, traceability, documentation, and governance, and contribute to standard guidance on AI-enabled workflows

Business Development and Market Support

Support PathWise growth in the North American life and annuity market through client solutioning, demonstrations (including AI-enabled capabilities), proposals, implementation estimates, and project planning.
Partner with senior leaders in client discussions on actuarial modernization, implementation strategy, process automation, AI-enabled transformation, and business value.
Develop proof-of-concept materials and presentations on PathWise capabilities, implementation guidelines, and emerging insurance industry issues.
Develop and share case studies, training materials, and thought leadership that showcase successful AI-enabled PathWise use cases and evolving capabilities

How this opportunity is different

PathWise is Aon’s high-performance actuarial software platform, enabling insurers to model liabilities, assets, capital, and related business processes with speed, transparency, flexibility, and control. The platform supports modern actuarial modelling, scenario analysis, financial reporting, ALM, risk management, and enterprise-scale production processes.

In this role, you will help clients migrate models and processes into PathWise, improve actuarial production workflows, and apply automation and AI-enabled capabilities across requirements, model development, testing, reconciliation, documentation, workflow monitoring, and reporting. You will also help identify new AI applications within PathWise, develop improvements with the PathWise AI team, and promote adoption of emerging capabilities across client and internal teams.

Skills And Experience That Will Lead To Success

10+ years of experience in life insurance, life reinsurance, actuarial consulting, financial technology, actuarial modelling, or enterprise platform implementation.
Experience with valuation, pricing, ALM, hedging, capital, financial reporting, risk management, model governance, or related actuarial functions.
Experience supporting or leading implementation, modernization, migration, or transformation projects within actuarial, finance, risk, or insurance technology environments.
Solid understanding of life and annuity products, reserves, capital, financial reporting, ALM, and risk management.
Practical experience with actuarial modelling platforms, model migration, data transformation, testing, reconciliation, workflow automation, documentation, and production process improvement.
Experience identifying and shaping AI-enabled transformation opportunities (e.g., automation, analytics, AI-assisted development, or generative AI applications) in actuarial or financial services processes, including working with development teams to refine and implement new features
Knowledge of programming, data workflows, Python, APIs, cloud infrastructure, or automation concepts is preferred.
Comfort acting as a bridge between actuarial users and technical AI / software teams, including providing structured feedback on prototypes and helping define success metrics and acceptance criteria for new capabilities
Strong project delivery, customer management, communication, and team leadership skills.
Member of the Society of Actuaries, Canadian Institute of Actuaries, or equivalent actuarial organization preferred.

Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate .

jobs.title: Director and Practice Lead, Data Engineering
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Welcome to TELUS Digital — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital agency and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture.

With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, Africa, and APAC, we offer end-to-end expertise across: Digital Product Strategy & Innovation, Digital Marketing Services, Web & Mobile App Development, Data & AI, Cloud Engineering, and Enterprise Technology Modernization.

From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are — all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi-billion-dollar parent company.

Location & Flexibility

Our Director & Practice Lead, Data Engineering
will operate remotely in Canada OR be based out of either our Toronto, ON or Vancouver, BC office locations.

The Opportunity

TELUS Digital's Data, AI & Cloud (DAIC) practice is the multidisciplinary engine behind enterprise AI, blending boutique innovation with the breadth of a global services portfolio to help organizations architect, scale, and secure their transformations. Spanning our full family of specialized capabilities, the DAIC practice delivers end-to-end solutions across AI Advisory, AI Solutions, Data & AI Platforms, and Cloud Transformation.

As a premier Google Cloud partner, our Cloud practice is at the forefront of helping enterprises adopt and scale on Google Cloud infrastructure: delivering complex engineering, deployment, and migration programs for some of the largest organizations in Canada and beyond.

The Director & Practice Lead, Data Engineering
will define and own the Data Engineering Practice along with its market positioning, P&L, talent, and the quality of work we deliver for clients. This role is for someone who has led data and AI practices before, understands how to turn messy enterprise data estates into strategic assets, and earns trust with C-suite executives through genuine expertise. You will shape how we help clients move from data ambition to durable, AI-ready infrastructure.

This Role Will Have Four Core Anchor Responsibilities

Strategy: Set the practice vision and align Data & AI capabilities to where enterprise demand is heading.
P&L: Own revenue targets, margin, and growth while being accountable for the practice's full commercial performance.
Talent & Culture: Build a practice where data-driven thinking, innovation, and engineering rigour are the baseline.
Client Impact: Act as a trusted advisor to enterprise CxOs navigating data strategy, AI adoption, and governance.

Responsibilities

Define the multi-year vision for the Data Engineering Practice, ensuring our technical capabilities are ahead of the curve for enterprise demand for Data & AI transformation.
Own the full P&L, including pipeline, pricing, delivery margin, and revenue growth, while reporting directly to executive leadership with clear commercial accountability.
Build and sustain senior relationships with Google Cloud partner teams and client executives to generate meaningful deal flow and expand strategic accounts.
Lead the practice's position on ethical AI and data democratisation while making principled, evidence-based bets on where advanced analytics and AI are creating real enterprise value.
Drive investment in reusable IP, data accelerators, and delivery assets that improve consistency, reduce time-to-value, and protect margins at scale.
Serve as a strategic advisor to client C-suite executives, helping them define data strategy, navigate AI adoption, and build the organisational capabilities to sustain it.
Set the standard for engineering and analytical excellence across the practice by hiring well, developing talent deliberately, and building teams that clients trust and return to.

Competencies

12+ years in data or AI consulting, including at least 3–5 years in a practice leadership or executive role, not just senior delivery or individual contribution.
Proven P&L ownership: Direct experience managing revenue, margin, and growth targets in a consulting or professional services context.
Data and AI ecosystem depth: Strong command of modern data architecture, AI, and ML trends, cloud-native data platforms, and enterprise data governance.
Executive communication: Able to advise, challenge, and build lasting trust with C-suite stakeholders on complex, ambiguous problems, not just present to them.
Business Development track record: Experience generating pipeline and closing complex, multi-stakeholder engagements, not just managing delivery once work is sold.
Talent leadership: Has hired, grown, and retained senior data engineering and consulting talent in a practice or delivery organisation.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At TELUS Digital, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All aspects of employment, including the decision to hire and promote, are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

We will only use the information you provide to process your application and to produce tracking statistics. Since we do not request personal data deemed sensitive, we ask you to abstain from sharing that information with us.

For more information on how we use your information, see our Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe
, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Position Description:

As Chief Technology Officer, you will drive execution for the product and engineering teams and put AI at the core of everything the company builds. You will own Toptal’s full technical architecture and you will build it AI-first—utilizing best practices for agentic engineering. AI is not a workstream inside the engineering team—it’s core to it.

You will create and own the AI architecture and best practices the rest of the company utilizes. You will also own the initiatives that put agents into production. You should know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up, how to engineer best-in-class harnesses, and how to create best practices for agentic engineering that engineering teams adopt to 10x their productivity—without sacrificing quality. Your mindset will be that of a builder and an architect, someone who solves problems in the system itself. No problem will be too large or too small for you to solve yourself. You will set the technical direction and hold the cadenced meetings that turn technical strategy into working, production-ready outcomes. You will be in the design reviews and in the code, not adjacent to them. You will move fast, and you will ensure our engineering team is never the reason an initiative slows down.

You are the technical owner of all Toptal’s products. You will collaborate closely with Product to design infrastructure that exposes Toptal’s core business logic through modular interfaces the rest of the business can build on. Alongside a group of hands-on executives, your engineering discipline directly shapes Toptal’s growth, profitability, and operational excellence.

You will own resourcing and workforce planning as a doer: scoping the work, sizing the teams, planning headcount against it, defining the role and the bar for every seat. None of that is beneath the role, and we are not interested in someone who thinks these tasks can be done properly by handing them off to HR. Hiring is the highest-leverage work you do, and we want someone who is visibly excited about hiring A-players—with a sense of urgency.

Then, you lead the team. You will set the standards, develop people against those standards, and know exactly who is meeting those standards.

You will be one of Toptal’s foremost experts on AI, and you will stay ahead of a field that never stops moving. You will coach engineers on agentic best practices, show the executive team what is newly possible with the new AI tooling, and push AI into every function at Toptal.

This role runs on high-energy execution and attention to detail. You will bring urgency to every part of it and measure yourself on outcomes. We are not looking for someone to oversee this work. We are looking for someone to drive it and get into the details.

This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

One precondition runs through all of it: you conceive the strategy. You will form your own view of where engineering and AI should go, build the case, and bring the CEO a strategy to react to, not a request for direction.

AI and agentic engineering

Own Toptal’s AI technology strategy and the architecture beneath it: model selection and fine-tuning, harness design, orchestration, retrieval, context engineering, tool and MCP integration, guardrails, evaluation, and cost control, exposed as primitives every team composes against.
Deploy agentic engineering at scale against the work that runs this business: matching, vetting, onboarding, delivery, and internal operations. Own the outcomes those agents are accountable for.
Make AI quality measurable. Own the evals, the regression suites, and the review loops, so quality here is proven rather than claimed.
Rebuild how the platform gets built and operated, raising output per engineer through AI-assisted development, review, testing, and operations. Engineers have to want this, not comply with it, and creating that pull is on you.

Team, resourcing, and accountability

Decide what a team should look like now that the roles have blurred, where the product manager believes they can design and code, the engineer believes they can do product and design, and the designer believes they can code and do product.
Own resourcing and workforce planning: scope the roadmap into buildable work, plan headcount and sequence, write the specs, and hit time-sensitive hiring commitments.
Own the bar for the team: assess talent honestly, develop people against the bar, and hold it as the organization grows.

Platform and execution

Own the architecture end-to-end, from services and data flows to interfaces and system boundaries, and hold the standards that keep it coherent as it grows.
Own throughput, reliability, and the platform layer beneath them, including the AI-dependent paths where latency, drift, and provider outages are real failure modes. Own build-versus-buy, technical debt, secure-by-design architecture, responsible AI, and the engineering and AI cost structure down to inference and token spend.

In the first week, expect to:

Learn Toptal’s model and platform architecture, and meet the leaders you will depend on across Engineering, Product, Industries, and Services.
Establish a direct, working rhythm with the CEO.

In the first month, expect to:

Assess the engineering function honestly, and assess AI maturity with it: what is really in production, what is measured, what is duplicated, and what should be shut down.
Assess the team against the bar this role requires, and bring the executive team a strategy no one asked you for.

In the first three months, expect to:

Be executing your own plan, with a review cadence and clear accountability at every level, and your resourcing plan presented.
Stand up the shared AI architecture and evals, and put one agentic workflow into production with a baseline and a measured result.

In the first six months, expect to:

Show business impact from agents in production in at least two core workflows, with the evidence behind it.
Have the leadership team you need, with the bar visibly raised, and throughput and reliability moving on the paths that matter most.

In the first year, expect to:

Run an engineering organization recognized inside and outside Toptal as one of the most advanced in the industry, with the pull on AI now coming from engineering.
Have AI leverage embedded in the architecture and the operating model, not living in a portfolio of pilots, and the team you built delivering against plan.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is required, and an advanced degree is strongly preferred.
15+ years of progressive engineering leadership, including significant time as a CTO or VP of Engineering, or as a direct report to one at meaningful scale.
Deep, current, hands-on command of modern AI engineering: foundation models, agentic architectures, harness design, retrieval, context engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation. You have shipped and operated these in production, and you know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up.
Agentic systems deployed at scale against real business processes, with measured outcomes on cost, cycle time, quality, or revenue, and a record of retiring what did not work.
Rigor about evaluation. You can explain precisely how you knew a model, prompt, or agent change was an improvement, and you can show the evidence.
Command of the economics underneath it: model routing, hosted versus self-hosted, inference capacity, latency and cost budgets, and staying portable across providers.
Further ahead on AI than the executives around you, able to teach it, and proven at moving an organization to adopt something it was not asking for.
You create strategy rather than administer it, and you win arguments on evidence rather than authority, including your view on what a team should look like in the age of AI.
Proven ownership of resourcing and workforce planning, and a hiring track record you can quantify. You have made the hard calls when someone was not clearing the bar.
Currently hands-on. You read and write code, you can take apart a design document or an eval harness and find the flaw in it, and you command distributed systems, service architecture, data-intensive applications, and cloud infrastructure at scale.
Experience scaling and modernizing a large existing codebase without stopping the business. You have replaced load-bearing systems in flight, not only built greenfield.
Experience leading a globally distributed, remote team at a technology or hyper-growth company is required. A high-volume, two-sided marketplace or multi-tenant platform is a significant plus.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
Speed, ownership, and quality. You move with urgency, decide without perfect information, and treat everything you deliver as a reflection of yourself.
You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Product Management – Lito Platform
jobs.description:
Job Description

Ready to Help Shape the Future of Legal Tech?!

At Litera, we don’t just build software, we transform how the world’s top law firms operate. Every day, we Raise The Bar™️ for what’s possible through AI, innovation, and solutions that power millions of legal professionals worldwide. If you’re energized by scale, real impact, and meaningful challenges, you’ll feel right at home here.

Where You’ll Work

This is a hybrid role based in Toronto with the expectations to be in office at least 3 days a week for collaboration and connection.

Why this Role Matters

As a Senior Director, Product Management at Litera, you will be part of a dynamic team that is passionate about driving innovation in the legal technology space. You will have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge tools and collaborate with industry experts to deliver solutions that make a real difference in the legal profession.

What You’ll Deliver

Product Strategy and Leadership

Define and own the long-term product vision and strategy for Lito, Litera’s GenAI platform and AI intelligence layer and the Litera One Web experience.
Translate firm-level business needs into a clear, prioritized roadmap aligned with Litera’s platform direction
Drive platform thinking across products, ensuring Lito delivers consistent, scalable integration across all Litera workflows
Identify market opportunities and shape product roadmaps for competitive advantage in the legal AI space
Leverage generative AI and LLM capabilities to deliver meaningful workflow automation and intelligence, not just chat interfaces
Balance near-term customer value with long-term architectural and platform investments
Optimize the Product Management Machine to empower your team

AI and Platform Expertise

Bring deep expertise in generative AI and Large Language Model (LLM) technologies, including hands-on experience shipping AI-powered products to enterprise customers
Think at both the platform level (architecture, integrations, shared services) and the workflow level (user tasks, friction points, adoption drivers)
Drive the evolution of Lito as an ecosystem platform, ensuring interoperability across Litera’s suite of legal tools
Stay ahead of the AI landscape to ensure Lito maintains a differentiated and forward-looking product position
Partner with Engineering, Design, and AI/ML teams to ensure high-quality, reliable, and performant AI experiences

Legal Industry Expertise A Plus

Bring strong understanding of how law firms operate across practice management, document workflows, matter management, and business development
Understand how legal professionals evaluate, buy, implement, and adopt AI-powered software, including change management and adoption dynamics
Act as a trusted product advisor to law firm partners, CIOs, legal operations leaders, and end users
Translate firm strategy, competitive pressures, and regulatory or compliance needs into AI product direction

Customer Engagement and Market Insight

Engage directly with customers to validate problems, test concepts, and refine AI solutions
Build strong relationships with key enterprise clients and strategic partners
Represent Lito and Litera One Web in customer briefings, roadmap discussions, and industry forums
Use data, customer feedback, and competitive analysis to continuously guide product decisions

Go-to-Market and Commercial Impact

Partner closely with product marketing, sales, customer success, and professional services to shape go-to-market strategies for Lito
Drive go-to-market strategies including pricing, positioning, and sales enablement
Influence packaging and positioning decisions for Lito’s AI capabilities across the Litera ecosystem
Support sales and account teams with clear product narratives and value articulation
Monitor market trends and the competitive AI landscape to inform product decisions

Cross-Functional Leadership and Execution

Controller & Director of Finance – Path to VP Finance Progressive Industrial Fluids Ltd.

London, Ontario | On-Site | Full-Time, Permanent

Compensation:
$130,000–$140,000+ base, depending on experience, plus performance-based incentive
Lead Finance Today. Grow Into VP Finance. Progressive Industrial Fluids is looking for an exceptional Controller & Director of Finance to take immediate leadership of our accounting and finance department and help build the financial infrastructure required for our next stage of growth.
This is more than a traditional Controller role.
We need someone who can lead the department today: strengthen accounting processes and controls, improve reporting, develop the team and provide leadership with reliable financial information for better decision-making.
For the right person, this role also offers a clear opportunity to progress into VP Finance.
A candidate who demonstrates strong leadership, delivers meaningful improvements, aligns with our organization and proves capable of operating at an executive level will have the opportunity to advance into the VP Finance role and earn a seat on our Executive Leadership Team.
About Progressive Industrial Fluids Progressive Industrial Fluids is a Canadian-owned manufacturer of specialty lubricants, metalworking fluids, stamping compounds and industrial chemical solutions. For nearly two decades, we have helped manufacturers improve processes, lower total operating costs and solve challenging production problems.
We have invested significantly in the foundation for our next stage of growth, including:
Modern ERP infrastructure through Odoo
Expanded manufacturing capabilities
In-house laboratory and technical services
Improved processes, workflows, costing and operational data
An established industrial customer base
A strategy to expand our Canadian business and enter key U.S. manufacturing markets

We now need a finance leader who can strengthen the department we have today while helping design the financial organization we will need tomorrow.
Your Initial Mandate You will become the senior internal leader of our accounting and finance function and work directly with ownership and senior leadership.
Your immediate priorities will include:
Leading and developing the accounting and finance team
Strengthening month-end and year-end processes
Improving financial reporting and management visibility
Establishing stronger controls and accountability
Improving budgeting, forecasting and cash-flow management
Strengthening product costing, inventory and margin analysis
Improving ERP data integrity and financial processes
Clarifying roles and responsibilities within the department
Identifying financial risks, weaknesses and opportunities
Creating a practical roadmap for the finance function

We want someone who can quickly understand where we are, determine what needs improvement and turn that assessment into action.
Path to VP Finance We are deliberately creating this role with room to grow.
You do not need to already hold a VP title. You may currently be a:
Director of Finance
Senior or Corporate Controller
Plant Controller
Divisional Finance Leader
Experienced Finance Manager ready for a larger mandate

Your current title matters less than what you have accomplished and what you are capable of building.
To progress toward VP Finance, you will need to demonstrate the ability to:
Lead the finance department effectively
Build trust with ownership and senior leadership
Develop people and create accountability
Identify risks before they become problems
Turn financial information into business decisions
Improve systems without creating unnecessary bureaucracy
Understand both the financial and operational sides of the business
Help prepare Progressive financially for significant growth

Financial & Operational Leadership As the role develops, your responsibility will extend well beyond accounting.
You will help us answer questions such as:
How much capital will our growth require?
How should we finance inventory and working capital as we scale?
Which customers, products and markets generate the strongest returns?
Where are we deploying capital effectively?
What systems and controls will we need at twice our current size?
How do we pursue aggressive growth without losing financial discipline?

Key areas of responsibility will include:
Cash-flow forecasting and working-capital management
Inventory investment and cash-conversion analysis
Accounts receivable and accounts payable strategy
Banking, lender reporting and financing requirements
Capital expenditure analysis
Budgeting, rolling forecasts and financial modelling
Raw-material, labour and manufacturing overhead analysis
Product costing and gross-margin performance
Customer and product-line profitability
KPI development and management reporting
Growth scenarios and capital planning

Our finance leader must be willing to understand how the business actually operates. You should be comfortable moving between the financial statements and the plant floor.
ERP, Systems & Data Our ERP platform is Odoo. Specific Odoo experience is an asset but is not required. What matters is your ability to understand ERP systems, improve data integrity, develop meaningful reporting and ensure technology gives management better information while reducing unnecessary administrative work.
Build the Finance Team We are not looking for someone who simply performs the work themselves. You will be expected to lead and mentor accounting and finance employees, establish clear expectations, improve accountability, identify skill or resource gaps and build a finance organization capable of supporting growth.
Who We're Looking For You should bring:
Progressive accounting and financial leadership experience
Strong manufacturing finance experience
Strong knowledge of financial statements and accounting controls
Experience leading month-end and year-end processes
Strong understanding of working capital, inventory and cash flow
Cost-accounting and margin-analysis capabilities
Experience with budgeting, forecasting and financial modelling
Experience with banks, lenders and external financial partners
Strong ERP and data-analysis capabilities
Experience improving financial systems and controls
The ability to communicate financial information to non-financial leaders
Demonstrated leadership of accounting or finance professionals

A CPA designation is strongly preferred, but accomplishments, leadership ability and manufacturing experience will carry significant weight.
The Person We're Looking For You are not looking for a comfortable accounting job. You want to build something.
You ask why, challenge assumptions constructively and recognize problems before they become crises. You can move between a detailed costing issue and a long-term strategic discussion.
You are comfortable respectfully challenging leadership when the numbers support your position, and you believe financial discipline should enable growth rather than prevent it.
Most importantly, you want your work to have a visible impact on the company you help build.
What Success Looks Like During your first 12–18 months, we expect measurable progress in:
Monthly and year-end financial reporting
Forecasting and cash management
Financial controls and accountability
Product and customer profitability analysis
Working-capital and inventory management
Banking and lender reporting
ERP utilization and financial data integrity
Finance team development and role clarity
Financial modelling for Canadian and U.S. expansion
Building the financial infrastructure required for a substantially larger company

Our Interview Process We are interested in more than your résumé and previous job titles.
Candidates who advance through our process should be prepared to discuss how they would approach their first several months at Progressive Industrial Fluids.
Finalist candidates should expect a discussion around the type of 30-, 60-, 90- and 180-day plan they would use to assess the department, establish priorities and begin strengthening the finance function.
We are not expecting you to know every answer before joining us. We want to understand how you think, how you establish priorities and how you turn an assessment into a plan.
Why Join Progressive Industrial Fluids? This is an opportunity to join an established Canadian manufacturer at an important point in its development.
The foundation has been built. The market opportunity exists. The growth strategy is taking shape.
For the right person, this role provides the opportunity to lead our finance function now, prove yourself as a senior financial leader and potentially advance into VP Finance with a seat on our Executive Leadership Team.
We aren't looking for someone who wants to inherit a finished finance department.
We're looking for someone who wants to build one.

About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe
, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Position Description:

As Chief Technology Officer, you will drive execution for the product and engineering teams and put AI at the core of everything the company builds. You will own Toptal’s full technical architecture and you will build it AI-first—utilizing best practices for agentic engineering. AI is not a workstream inside the engineering team—it’s core to it.

You will create and own the AI architecture and best practices the rest of the company utilizes. You will also own the initiatives that put agents into production. You should know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up, how to engineer best-in-class harnesses, and how to create best practices for agentic engineering that engineering teams adopt to 10x their productivity—without sacrificing quality. Your mindset will be that of a builder and an architect, someone who solves problems in the system itself. No problem will be too large or too small for you to solve yourself. You will set the technical direction and hold the cadenced meetings that turn technical strategy into working, production-ready outcomes. You will be in the design reviews and in the code, not adjacent to them. You will move fast, and you will ensure our engineering team is never the reason an initiative slows down.

You are the technical owner of all Toptal’s products. You will collaborate closely with Product to design infrastructure that exposes Toptal’s core business logic through modular interfaces the rest of the business can build on. Alongside a group of hands-on executives, your engineering discipline directly shapes Toptal’s growth, profitability, and operational excellence.

You will own resourcing and workforce planning as a doer: scoping the work, sizing the teams, planning headcount against it, defining the role and the bar for every seat. None of that is beneath the role, and we are not interested in someone who thinks these tasks can be done properly by handing them off to HR. Hiring is the highest-leverage work you do, and we want someone who is visibly excited about hiring A-players—with a sense of urgency.

Then, you lead the team. You will set the standards, develop people against those standards, and know exactly who is meeting those standards.

You will be one of Toptal’s foremost experts on AI, and you will stay ahead of a field that never stops moving. You will coach engineers on agentic best practices, show the executive team what is newly possible with the new AI tooling, and push AI into every function at Toptal.

This role runs on high-energy execution and attention to detail. You will bring urgency to every part of it and measure yourself on outcomes. We are not looking for someone to oversee this work. We are looking for someone to drive it and get into the details.

This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

One precondition runs through all of it: you conceive the strategy. You will form your own view of where engineering and AI should go, build the case, and bring the CEO a strategy to react to, not a request for direction.

AI and agentic engineering

Own Toptal’s AI technology strategy and the architecture beneath it: model selection and fine-tuning, harness design, orchestration, retrieval, context engineering, tool and MCP integration, guardrails, evaluation, and cost control, exposed as primitives every team composes against.
Deploy agentic engineering at scale against the work that runs this business: matching, vetting, onboarding, delivery, and internal operations. Own the outcomes those agents are accountable for.
Make AI quality measurable. Own the evals, the regression suites, and the review loops, so quality here is proven rather than claimed.
Rebuild how the platform gets built and operated, raising output per engineer through AI-assisted development, review, testing, and operations. Engineers have to want this, not comply with it, and creating that pull is on you.

Team, resourcing, and accountability

Decide what a team should look like now that the roles have blurred, where the product manager believes they can design and code, the engineer believes they can do product and design, and the designer believes they can code and do product.
Own resourcing and workforce planning: scope the roadmap into buildable work, plan headcount and sequence, write the specs, and hit time-sensitive hiring commitments.
Own the bar for the team: assess talent honestly, develop people against the bar, and hold it as the organization grows.

Platform and execution

Own the architecture end-to-end, from services and data flows to interfaces and system boundaries, and hold the standards that keep it coherent as it grows.
Own throughput, reliability, and the platform layer beneath them, including the AI-dependent paths where latency, drift, and provider outages are real failure modes. Own build-versus-buy, technical debt, secure-by-design architecture, responsible AI, and the engineering and AI cost structure down to inference and token spend.

In the first week, expect to:

Learn Toptal’s model and platform architecture, and meet the leaders you will depend on across Engineering, Product, Industries, and Services.
Establish a direct, working rhythm with the CEO.

In the first month, expect to:

Assess the engineering function honestly, and assess AI maturity with it: what is really in production, what is measured, what is duplicated, and what should be shut down.
Assess the team against the bar this role requires, and bring the executive team a strategy no one asked you for.

In the first three months, expect to:

Be executing your own plan, with a review cadence and clear accountability at every level, and your resourcing plan presented.
Stand up the shared AI architecture and evals, and put one agentic workflow into production with a baseline and a measured result.

In the first six months, expect to:

Show business impact from agents in production in at least two core workflows, with the evidence behind it.
Have the leadership team you need, with the bar visibly raised, and throughput and reliability moving on the paths that matter most.

In the first year, expect to:

Run an engineering organization recognized inside and outside Toptal as one of the most advanced in the industry, with the pull on AI now coming from engineering.
Have AI leverage embedded in the architecture and the operating model, not living in a portfolio of pilots, and the team you built delivering against plan.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is required, and an advanced degree is strongly preferred.
15+ years of progressive engineering leadership, including significant time as a CTO or VP of Engineering, or as a direct report to one at meaningful scale.
Deep, current, hands-on command of modern AI engineering: foundation models, agentic architectures, harness design, retrieval, context engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation. You have shipped and operated these in production, and you know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up.
Agentic systems deployed at scale against real business processes, with measured outcomes on cost, cycle time, quality, or revenue, and a record of retiring what did not work.
Rigor about evaluation. You can explain precisely how you knew a model, prompt, or agent change was an improvement, and you can show the evidence.
Command of the economics underneath it: model routing, hosted versus self-hosted, inference capacity, latency and cost budgets, and staying portable across providers.
Further ahead on AI than the executives around you, able to teach it, and proven at moving an organization to adopt something it was not asking for.
You create strategy rather than administer it, and you win arguments on evidence rather than authority, including your view on what a team should look like in the age of AI.
Proven ownership of resourcing and workforce planning, and a hiring track record you can quantify. You have made the hard calls when someone was not clearing the bar.
Currently hands-on. You read and write code, you can take apart a design document or an eval harness and find the flaw in it, and you command distributed systems, service architecture, data-intensive applications, and cloud infrastructure at scale.
Experience scaling and modernizing a large existing codebase without stopping the business. You have replaced load-bearing systems in flight, not only built greenfield.
Experience leading a globally distributed, remote team at a technology or hyper-growth company is required. A high-volume, two-sided marketplace or multi-tenant platform is a significant plus.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
Speed, ownership, and quality. You move with urgency, decide without perfect information, and treat everything you deliver as a reflection of yourself.
You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

new_jobs.title: Director of Finance & Controller
new_jobs.description:
Controller & Director of Finance – Path to VP Finance Progressive Industrial Fluids Ltd.

London, Ontario | On-Site | Full-Time, Permanent

Compensation:
$130,000–$140,000+ base, depending on experience, plus performance-based incentive
Lead Finance Today. Grow Into VP Finance. Progressive Industrial Fluids is looking for an exceptional Controller & Director of Finance to take immediate leadership of our accounting and finance department and help build the financial infrastructure required for our next stage of growth.
This is more than a traditional Controller role.
We need someone who can lead the department today: strengthen accounting processes and controls, improve reporting, develop the team and provide leadership with reliable financial information for better decision-making.
For the right person, this role also offers a clear opportunity to progress into VP Finance.
A candidate who demonstrates strong leadership, delivers meaningful improvements, aligns with our organization and proves capable of operating at an executive level will have the opportunity to advance into the VP Finance role and earn a seat on our Executive Leadership Team.
About Progressive Industrial Fluids Progressive Industrial Fluids is a Canadian-owned manufacturer of specialty lubricants, metalworking fluids, stamping compounds and industrial chemical solutions. For nearly two decades, we have helped manufacturers improve processes, lower total operating costs and solve challenging production problems.
We have invested significantly in the foundation for our next stage of growth, including:
Modern ERP infrastructure through Odoo
Expanded manufacturing capabilities
In-house laboratory and technical services
Improved processes, workflows, costing and operational data
An established industrial customer base
A strategy to expand our Canadian business and enter key U.S. manufacturing markets

We now need a finance leader who can strengthen the department we have today while helping design the financial organization we will need tomorrow.
Your Initial Mandate You will become the senior internal leader of our accounting and finance function and work directly with ownership and senior leadership.
Your immediate priorities will include:
Leading and developing the accounting and finance team
Strengthening month-end and year-end processes
Improving financial reporting and management visibility
Establishing stronger controls and accountability
Improving budgeting, forecasting and cash-flow management
Strengthening product costing, inventory and margin analysis
Improving ERP data integrity and financial processes
Clarifying roles and responsibilities within the department
Identifying financial risks, weaknesses and opportunities
Creating a practical roadmap for the finance function

We want someone who can quickly understand where we are, determine what needs improvement and turn that assessment into action.
Path to VP Finance We are deliberately creating this role with room to grow.
You do not need to already hold a VP title. You may currently be a:
Director of Finance
Senior or Corporate Controller
Plant Controller
Divisional Finance Leader
Experienced Finance Manager ready for a larger mandate

Your current title matters less than what you have accomplished and what you are capable of building.
To progress toward VP Finance, you will need to demonstrate the ability to:
Lead the finance department effectively
Build trust with ownership and senior leadership
Develop people and create accountability
Identify risks before they become problems
Turn financial information into business decisions
Improve systems without creating unnecessary bureaucracy
Understand both the financial and operational sides of the business
Help prepare Progressive financially for significant growth

Financial & Operational Leadership As the role develops, your responsibility will extend well beyond accounting.
You will help us answer questions such as:
How much capital will our growth require?
How should we finance inventory and working capital as we scale?
Which customers, products and markets generate the strongest returns?
Where are we deploying capital effectively?
What systems and controls will we need at twice our current size?
How do we pursue aggressive growth without losing financial discipline?

Key areas of responsibility will include:
Cash-flow forecasting and working-capital management
Inventory investment and cash-conversion analysis
Accounts receivable and accounts payable strategy
Banking, lender reporting and financing requirements
Capital expenditure analysis
Budgeting, rolling forecasts and financial modelling
Raw-material, labour and manufacturing overhead analysis
Product costing and gross-margin performance
Customer and product-line profitability
KPI development and management reporting
Growth scenarios and capital planning

Our finance leader must be willing to understand how the business actually operates. You should be comfortable moving between the financial statements and the plant floor.
ERP, Systems & Data Our ERP platform is Odoo. Specific Odoo experience is an asset but is not required. What matters is your ability to understand ERP systems, improve data integrity, develop meaningful reporting and ensure technology gives management better information while reducing unnecessary administrative work.
Build the Finance Team We are not looking for someone who simply performs the work themselves. You will be expected to lead and mentor accounting and finance employees, establish clear expectations, improve accountability, identify skill or resource gaps and build a finance organization capable of supporting growth.
Who We're Looking For You should bring:
Progressive accounting and financial leadership experience
Strong manufacturing finance experience
Strong knowledge of financial statements and accounting controls
Experience leading month-end and year-end processes
Strong understanding of working capital, inventory and cash flow
Cost-accounting and margin-analysis capabilities
Experience with budgeting, forecasting and financial modelling
Experience with banks, lenders and external financial partners
Strong ERP and data-analysis capabilities
Experience improving financial systems and controls
The ability to communicate financial information to non-financial leaders
Demonstrated leadership of accounting or finance professionals

A CPA designation is strongly preferred, but accomplishments, leadership ability and manufacturing experience will carry significant weight.
The Person We're Looking For You are not looking for a comfortable accounting job. You want to build something.
You ask why, challenge assumptions constructively and recognize problems before they become crises. You can move between a detailed costing issue and a long-term strategic discussion.
You are comfortable respectfully challenging leadership when the numbers support your position, and you believe financial discipline should enable growth rather than prevent it.
Most importantly, you want your work to have a visible impact on the company you help build.
What Success Looks Like During your first 12–18 months, we expect measurable progress in:
Monthly and year-end financial reporting
Forecasting and cash management
Financial controls and accountability
Product and customer profitability analysis
Working-capital and inventory management
Banking and lender reporting
ERP utilization and financial data integrity
Finance team development and role clarity
Financial modelling for Canadian and U.S. expansion
Building the financial infrastructure required for a substantially larger company

Our Interview Process We are interested in more than your résumé and previous job titles.
Candidates who advance through our process should be prepared to discuss how they would approach their first several months at Progressive Industrial Fluids.
Finalist candidates should expect a discussion around the type of 30-, 60-, 90- and 180-day plan they would use to assess the department, establish priorities and begin strengthening the finance function.
We are not expecting you to know every answer before joining us. We want to understand how you think, how you establish priorities and how you turn an assessment into a plan.
Why Join Progressive Industrial Fluids? This is an opportunity to join an established Canadian manufacturer at an important point in its development.
The foundation has been built. The market opportunity exists. The growth strategy is taking shape.
For the right person, this role provides the opportunity to lead our finance function now, prove yourself as a senior financial leader and potentially advance into VP Finance with a seat on our Executive Leadership Team.
We aren't looking for someone who wants to inherit a finished finance department.
We're looking for someone who wants to build one.
Compensation & Benefits $130,000–$140,000+ base salary, depending on experience
Performance-based incentive opportunity
RRSP matching program
Comprehensive health, dental and vision benefits
Paid vacation
Company events
On-site parking

Job description:

Job Overview
We are seeking a dynamic and strategic Director of Finance to lead our financial operations and drive fiscal excellence across the organization. In this pivotal role, you will oversee all aspects of financial planning, reporting, and analysis, ensuring the company’s financial health and supporting sustainable growth. Your leadership will empower teams to excel in managing budgets, optimizing costs, and mitigating financial risks. This role offers an exciting opportunity to shape financial strategies that propel the organization forward with confidence and clarity.
Responsibilities
Develop and implement comprehensive financial strategies aligned with organizational goals to foster growth and stability.
Oversee full-cycle accounting and payroll functions to ensure accuracy and compliance.
Lead budgeting efforts by preparing detailed financial forecasts, monitoring variances, and recommending corrective actions.
Conduct risk analysis and develop risk management strategies to safeguard assets and ensure regulatory compliance.
Manage investment activities, evaluating opportunities for business development and expansion while maintaining prudent risk controls.
Provide leadership to finance teams, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and professional development.
Collaborate with executive leadership on strategic initiatives, offering insights on financial implications and investment opportunities.

Requirements
Proven experience in corporate finance, financial services, or related fields with a strong background in accounting principles.
Demonstrated leadership skills with the ability to manage cross-functional teams effectively.
Expertise in budgeting, cost management, risk analysis, and risk management practices.
Proficiency in account reconciliation, bookkeeping software, and financial management tools.
Strong understanding of investment strategies and business development processes.
Excellent analytical skills with keen attention to detail and problem-solving capabilities.
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting or a related discipline;
Advanced certification such as CPA or CFA are preferred.

Join us as our Director of Finance, where your expertise will shape our financial future! Bring your energy, strategic mindset, and passion for excellence to a role that challenges you to lead with confidence while making a tangible impact on our organization’s success.

Dental care
Extended health care
Life insurance
On-site parking
